svg.aria-label: Constructed signals, seed 820: ζ=−25 mV, viscosity 0.89 mPa·s, relative permittivity 78.4, constant flow 3 μm/s, projected optical coefficient 3×10⁶ m⁻¹. A shows two phase records; B fits six fields; C retains phase residuals. D adds an electro-osmotic slope 0.5×10⁻⁸ m²/(V·s), illustrating a term that polarity reversal alone leaves in the result.
